article.title: 百度開源Unlimited OCR 2，主打長文件結構化及跨頁表格合併
article.title_en: Baidu releases Unlimited OCR 2 for long-document structure and cross-page tables
article.summary: 百度於10月27日宣布開源文心Unlimited OCR 2，描述可輸出結構化文件、識別版面要素及合併跨頁表格；生產級平台能力另列為公開測試。
article.summary_en: Baidu announced open-source Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 on October 27, describing structured document output, layout recognition and cross-page table merging. Production-oriented platform capabilities are separately offered in public testing.
article.why: 處理研究報告、供應商文件及多頁產品資料的行銷團隊，可評估抽取流程。這類工具適合減少整理工作，關鍵數字與表格仍需回看原件。
article.why_en: Marketing teams handling research, supplier documents and product information can evaluate extraction workflows, retaining original-page checks for critical numbers and tables.
article.next_step: 先用公開、非敏感文件比較表格欄位、閱讀順序及跨頁合併，再檢查授權及部署要求。
article.next_step_en: Compare table fields, reading order and cross-page merging on public non-sensitive documents, then check licensing and deployment requirements.
highlights: 官方描述可識別標題、段落、表格、公式及圖片等版面要素，並輸出結構層級。
公告提供GitHub與Hugging Face模型入口；平台生產級能力須另行參與公測。
highlights_en: Baidu describes recognizing headings, paragraphs, tables, formulas and images with structural hierarchy.
The announcement links GitHub and Hugging Face; production platform capabilities require separate public-test participation.
article.detail:
百度於10月27日宣布開源文心Unlimited OCR 2，描述可輸出結構化文件、識別版面要素及合併跨頁表格；生產級平台能力另列為公開測試。

官方描述可識別標題、段落、表格、公式及圖片等版面要素，並輸出結構層級。

公告提供GitHub與Hugging Face模型入口；平台生產級能力須另行參與公測。

處理研究報告、供應商文件及多頁產品資料的行銷團隊，可評估抽取流程。這類工具適合減少整理工作，關鍵數字與表格仍需回看原件。

先用公開、非敏感文件比較表格欄位、閱讀順序及跨頁合併，再檢查授權及部署要求。

能力按百度公告歸因；本刊未重現基準分數、未證實任何長度皆可正確處理，亦未完成模型授權審查。
article.detail_en:
Baidu announced open-source Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 on October 27, describing structured document output, layout recognition and cross-page table merging. Production-oriented platform capabilities are separately offered in public testing.

Baidu describes recognizing headings, paragraphs, tables, formulas and images with structural hierarchy.

The announcement links GitHub and Hugging Face; production platform capabilities require separate public-test participation.

Marketing teams handling research, supplier documents and product information can evaluate extraction workflows, retaining original-page checks for critical numbers and tables.

Compare table fields, reading order and cross-page merging on public non-sensitive documents, then check licensing and deployment requirements.

Capabilities are attributed to Baidu. Benchmark scores and unlimited-length accuracy were not reproduced, and model licensing has not been reviewed.
